entities.name: 垂直整合 (vertically integrated)

evidence.quote: And so we're really excited about how really all the new technology is enabling a vertically integrated industrial business like us to just keep separating our moat from the existing industry we live in.

entities.name: 运营数据点 (operational data points)
entities.how_described: 本集称 Stored 每年处理约 80 亿个运营数据点——从库存放置、需求规划到手部动作标注——每年 1 亿个包裹、覆盖美国约三分之一家庭、GMV 近 200 亿美元,是机器人实验室最想获取的数据富矿。

evidence.quote: 8 billion operational data points.

evidence.quote: Yeah, for us, we process about 8 billion operational data points a year, and that could be anything from how to place a piece of inventory in the network to how to plan for certain consumer demand to how a unit is picked in the facility with labeling on the hands so that they can learn all of these different picking and packing patterns.

entities.name: 飞轮 (flywheel)
entities.how_described: 本集把 Stored 的业务飞轮描述为:服务的量越大,成本越低、速度越快、信任越高;规模同时驱动经济性和网络密度,是配送护城河的来源,并让销售赢单率从不到 10% 升到 50% 以上。

evidence.quote: And the flywheel of this business is that the more volume you serve, the lower cost, the faster speed, and the greater trust.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

evidence.quote: And so the race to scale and spin that flywheel to level the playing field is really on and we're in the lead.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

evidence.quote: And for us, a lot of it comes back to that flywheel where
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_03

evidence.quote: And as we've spun that flywheel, we can trace our win rate in sales from sub 10% to over 50% because these brands can't find that level of capability elsewhere.

entities.name: 滚动式收购 (roll-up)
entities.how_described: 本集说 Stored 的收购不同于此标签:每笔既买网络里的密度和单量,又把自己的单位经济和软件贯穿进去,多数交易在极短时间内让被收购业务的效率、进而盈利能力提升 5 到 7 倍甚至更高。

evidence.quote: So are you a roll up?

evidence.quote: And now you're seeing these new applied kind of roll-up companies, holdings companies, and more saying, wait a second, I can build the best accounting software or whatever it may be, but if the accounting industry is slow to adopt, what if I go accrue all that advantage into my own company and my own accounting service where I own the data, the customer, and the software and AI powering this?

entities.name: 应用层 (application layer)
entities.how_described: 本集最大胆的观点:价值不会持续累积到 AI 和机器人技术,而会积累到应用层和现实世界;长远看真正被商品化的反而是高速增长的 AI 公司和机器人技术。

evidence.quote: I think it actually accrues to the application layer and to the real world.
